entry.title: New: Resolution 654 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — now tracked
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO PATH – PEOPLE FOR ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION HAWAI‘I FOR EXPENSES RELATED TO THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF BICYCLE RACKS AT KAILUA PARK AND KAILUA VILLAGE

Transfers $5,200 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 7)
